evidence: INFERRED from public team histories (base defensive front of the named coordinator's scheme that season) and cross-checked against each roster's own heavy-end share by tests/mod_editor/test_nfl2k5_front_schemes.py; not witnessed in game. A team-season not listed keeps the historic 4-3 rule, which is what every build before b776 gave every historic file. The retail group cites its source per team-season in retail_sources (Pro Football Reference team pages list a Defensive Alignment).
about: b776-de1 (Noah, 10/18 playtest: Kayvon Thibodeaux at middle linebacker and Leonard Williams at edge on the 22 Giants classic team). The generated rosters label players with retail positions (DE / DT / OLB / ILB). The One-pool build used to turn every one of them with the 4-3 rule (OLB to LB, DE to EDGE), which is wrong for a team-season that ran a 3-4: its pass-rushing outside linebackers became LBs and its heavy ends became EDGE. These lists name the team-seasons that ran a 3-4 so the 3-4 rule applies to them (OLB to EDGE, DE to the interior pool). See nfl2k5_front_schemes.mapping_scheme for when the rule is used (a pure 3-4 stock book keeps the retail slot meaning). b776-de2 added the retail group: the 75 retail historic ROST files (outer entries 113 to 187) are reclassified by tools/nfl2k5_roster_reclassify with the 4-3 rule unless their entry is in retail_entries, which are team-seasons whose base front is sourced as a 3-4 and whose franchise book (retail_books) asks the pools for roles.

classic.seahawks_2025: Mike Macdonald odd-front base (three heavy ends on the roster)

retail.broncos_1977: Joe Collier 3-4 (Orange Crush), full time from 1977
retail.raiders_1976: John Madden switched to the 3-4 in 1976

heavy_end_cross_check.about: Cross-check used by the unit test: share of a team's three top-depth DE rows at 280 lb or more. Every listed 3-4 team is at 1/3 or more; every UNLISTED team at 2/3 or more is named here as reviewed and left on the 4-3 rule.

browns_1986: https://ouatsports.com/1986-cleveland-browns-sports-history-articles/ (3-4 scheme, Hairston and Camp at end)

retail_reviewed_left_four_three.chiefs_1993: de1 listed it; no source found that states the 1993 front, and Pro Football Reference lists the 1992 Chiefs (same coordinator) as 4-3. Left on the 4-3 rule.
retail_reviewed_left_four_three.rams_1979: Pro Football Reference: Defensive Alignment 4-3 (Ray Malavasi, Bud Carson).
retail_reviewed_left_four_three.jets_1998: Pro Football Reference: Defensive Alignment 4-3 (Parcells, Belichick).
retail_reviewed_left_four_three.49ers_1981: Only a fan article says 3-4 (not explicit); left on the 4-3 rule until a source states it.
retail_reviewed_left_four_three.dolphins_1972: The 53 defense: sources disagree whether the base was 4-3 or 3-4; left on the 4-3 rule.
